1. Speaker Liaisons


I reckon we could recruit some RLadies as Speaker Liaisons for the conference.

Essentially the Speaker Liaisons are responsible for direct contact with the speakers and presenters in the run-up to the conference.
For 40 speakers, 2 or 3 speaker liaisons would be the right number, as well as one for workshops.

It seems like an easy trivial job, but actually it is something that has worked really well for events I was involved in previously.

In part this is because the main organizers are typically stressed out about the next session, and dont tend to think about who was on already.
That is understandable, of course, but have a speaker liaison definitely helps the speaker not get forgotten about.

Also it allows people to get to know each other, and bring a nice social vibe to the conference.

I think, in hindsight, a Speaker Liaison would have helped in JuliaCon 2018.
